content: प्रसृत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Gone forward. .²2 Stretched out, extended. .²3 Spread, diffused. .²4 Long, lengthened. .²5 Engaged in, attached to; अष्टकापितृदेवत्यमित्ययं प्रसृतो जनः. <ls>Rām. 2. 108. 14</ls>. .²6 Swift, or quick. .²7 Manifested, displayed; न तेजस्तेजस्वी प्रसृतमपरेषां विषहते <ls>U. 6. 14</ls>. .²8 Modest, humble. .²9 Devoted (निष्ठावत्); त्यागिनः प्रसृतस्येह नोच्छित्तिर्विद्यते क्वचित् <ls>Mb. 12. 12. 19</ls>. .²10 Knowing subtle meaning (सूक्ष्मार्थगामिन्); <ls>Mb. 12. 118. 14</ls>. .²11 = पक्व; अतिथिः प्रसृताग्रभुक् <ls>Mb. 13. 35. 1</ls>. .{@-तः@} The palm of the hand stretched out and hollowed. .{@-तः, -तम्@} A measure equal to two {%palas%}. .{@-तम्@} Grass, plants etc; agriculture. .{@-ता@} The leg.
